definitions.explanation: A celestial body orbiting a planet, like the moon.
A man-made object orbiting Earth or another body.

examples.english: They are observing Earth's conditions using satellites.

notes:
{衛星|えいせい} covers both natural satellites (moons) and artificial satellites. The word comes from {衛|えい} (guard, protect) + {星|せい} (star), evoking a body that "guards" or orbits a larger one.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{衛星|えいせい}: artificial satellite
- {衛星|えいせい}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧: satellite broadcasting
- ⟦{気象|きしょう}→気象：09943_kishou⟧{衛星|えいせい}: weather satellite
- ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧{衛星|えいせい}: communications satellite
- {衛星|えいせい}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: satellite photo

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {衛星|えいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧: to launch a satellite
- {衛星|えいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: a satellite enters orbit

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{衛生|えいせい}→衛生：14049_eisei⟧ (hygiene) — same reading but different kanji ({星|せい} vs. {生|せい}).
